note: METHOD: three background scripts (MusicBrainz artist search batched eight names to a request, then works with recording relations; Deezer album search on the name with album details; Apple composerTerm song search for every composer whose MusicBrainz entry held no recorded works) plus one IMSLP API pass over all 585 pages (publisher, first performance, notes); hits were opened through Apple/Deezer track lists, MusicBrainz releases, IMSLP work info and 9 web searches / 1 fetch. Apple's shared 3.3 s clock was the bottleneck, but the composerTerm search ran for 139 composers (all whose MusicBrainz entry held no recorded works) and none is left unsearched. TRIAGE RESULT: 152 composers; 7 have kept works (Alexandra, Bedetti, Di Gesu, Dyson, Eatock, Diz, Balsach), 37 are spared from exclusion because something independent turned up (a label recording of other works, a Wikipedia or institutional presence, or professional performances named on IMSLP) but none of their chamber pages is recorded, and 107 are proposed in exclude_composers (self-published IMSLP uploads, no recording on an established label, no named professional performance; self-released streaming albums under the composer's own name were not counted). WEAK POINTS: (1) Jazz: Abreu's three pages (jazz combos, commercially recorded on Bis Music and live) are skipped as out of scope; the owner may add them. (2) Kept at low or medium confidence: Balsach (self-produced CD with a Paris string trio); Alexandra's Good Morning Sue and Melody for Orange Fiddle (Electrecord EDC 757, players not credited); Bedetti SQ 1 (Curci release names no players); Di Gesu's two quartets (performances documented by Wikipedia and IMSLP, no commercial recording); Diz's Fantasía Tanguera No. 6 (BlueArt Records) and the three works added from Tangabile. (3) IMSLP's own performance notes (Dyson's Stone with the Fitzwilliam Quartet, Aponte's quartet with the Juárez Quartet, Beischer-Matyó, Cibisescu-Duran, De Bleser, Alencar) were not corroborated and did not carry works. (4) Aponte's two recorded pieces are on his own album (℗ Gerardo Aponte Cupido) and were skipped. (5) Common names (Bell, Bennett, Brown, Cameron, Barber, Diaz ...) are swamped by namesakes: their 'none found' is weak. (6) Ernesto Bertini is a historical manuscript composer, not a living one, and is not proposed. Levels are estimates without scores. BY HAND (orchestrating session, 2026-10-17, on the owner's instruction to leave off lesser-known works that raise flags): 1 work(s) the agent kept at low confidence were moved to skipped (reason "doubtful") and parked in data/chamber/curation/parked-low-confidence.json: Balsach: String Trio.
